assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A is authenticated as fixture UI-ADMIN-01 with the case-specific permissions

2. And the Tile admin screen is open for UI-ADMIN-01; fixture record 101 is active and has Tile Name Fixture Tile; its owner is TEST_OWNER; Application Category Fixture Category is selected; the deactivate response returns record 101 with active false
3. When Admin A clicks icon button named "Deactivate" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid
4. And Admin A clicks button named "Deactivate" inside the dialog named "deactivate ID: 101" inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
5. Then cell named "Verified?" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid contains the error icon with tooltip "Unverified or Deactivated"
6. And icon button named "Verify" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid is enabled
7. And icon button named "Deactivate" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid is disabled
8. And dialog named "deactivate ID: 101" inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel is absent
